rule.statement: A shared mobility device may not be parked at the end of a trip inside a no-park or no-ride polygon.
rule.authority: RFQ033920 scope items 3.4.14 and 3.4.15 establish the prohibition; the City geofencing feed supplies the geometry
rule.fee_and_cure_basis: DEMONSTRATION ASSUMPTION — not from an executed agreement
rule.fee_and_cure_note: The RFP's functional requirements are not authority for a fine amount or a cure period. Both are placeholders pending the executed City/operator agreement, which supplies the real figures.
